paragraphs.text: And I pray, Heavenly Father, that You will bless these people, and today lay Your hand upon them and take away all their iniquity and doubt. And may they throw away their old moth-eaten robe of self- righteousness, where the canker worms and the crickets, and the moths of superstitions and churchianity, have eat holes through it, and (they) it won’t hold any longer. May they just throw it away, and reach over and get the robe of the Lord Jesus. Say, “I trust in Him. I wrap myself, not in my righteousness, nor on my own thoughts. But, from this hour on, I’m trusting You.” Grant that they’ll receive it, Father, for we ask it in Christ’s Name. Amen.
